displayed_blocks.label: inspect, acquire, reuse, and prune a managed runtime cache entry

assertions: cold acquisition downloads Codex 0.156.1 and lists one valid receipt with target and SHA-256
second pinned acquisition records only a cache_hit progress event
prune removes no entry while runtime leases are active
after releasing both leases prune removes the project-created cache entry

compatibility.mode: pinned vendor runtime acquisition, no provider or harness session
compatibility.status: verified on macOS arm64 against the upstream release asset; does not verify provider authentication or agent execution

network: Requires HTTPS access to the Codex release manifest and matching release asset for the current target.
credentials: No credentials, provider login, or model are used.
cleanup: The script treats its source directory as the project root, creates a separate temporary cache and progress file, prunes its one entry after releasing leases, then TemporaryDirectory removes only that cache workspace.
